name: move-fraud-to-aci
pattern: move the fraudulent transactions towards a different authorization
operation: fees on the merchant's fraudulent transactions recomputed per ACI, then argmin
invariant: the chosen ACI's cost is ≤ every alternative in the same table

guidelines.guideline: Answer must be just the selected ACI to incentive and the associated cost rounded to 2 decimals in this format: {card_scheme}:{fee}. If a question does not have a relevant or applicable answer for the task, please respond with 'Not Applicable'

canonical_method.helper: total_fees_paid_with_aci_override(fees, fraud_transactions, new_aci, account_type, mcc, capture_delay, monthly_fraud_level, monthly_volume) — proposed new helper
steps: fraud_txns = period transactions where has_fraudulent_dispute is true
current_acis = fraud_txns['aci'].unique() — these must be EXCLUDED from the candidate set, since the question asks for a DIFFERENT ACI
for each month (if period > 1 month): stats = monthly_merchant_stats(...); cd_bucket = capture_delay_bucket(info['capture_delay'])
for each candidate ACI not in current_acis: cost = fee cost of fraud_txns as if aci==candidate, summed across months
argmin over candidates only (never re-select an ACI already in current_acis)

conflict_ruling: task 2767 explicitly separates the CURRENT ACI's cost from the alternatives and picks the cheapest ALTERNATIVE (excluding current) — this matches the question's wording 'move towards a different ACI' and is the correct interpretation. Tasks 2746 and 2755 both computed a full per-ACI cost table but then picked the ACI that was ALREADY the current one for 100% of the merchant's fraud transactions (G in both cases) as their 'preferred different choice' — this contradicts the question and is almost certainly why dev-anchor task 2697 FAILed.
pitfalls: Selecting the argmin ACI without excluding the fraud transactions' current ACI(s) answers a different question than the one asked ('different ACI' means excluding status quo) — this is the leading suspect for the 2697 dev failure
Period spanning a full year needs the per-month bucket loop (task 2767 did this; simpler traces on single-month questions don't need it)
No existing helper supports 'recompute fees as if these transactions had a different ACI' — currently hand-rolled per task, inviting drift

few_shot.question: Looking at the year 2023 and at the merchant Belles_cookbook_store, if we were to move the fraudulent transactions towards a different ACI ... what would be the preferred choice?
few_shot.code: min({aci: cost for aci, cost in results.items() if aci != current_aci}, key=results.get)

prompt_rule: if the question asks which DIFFERENT ACI a merchant should move fraudulent transactions to → compute per-ACI cost for fraud transactions only, EXCLUDE the ACI(s) already used by those fraud transactions from the candidate set, then argmin; format: {aci}:{fee} rounded to 2 decimals.
note: This is the family with a confirmed gold failure (2697) plus a concrete, well-evidenced mechanism for it — top priority for the optimiser.
